note: Rustic state forest campground on 52-acre Shoepac Lake in the Mackinaw State Forest, 12 miles southeast of Onaway via M-33 South and Tomahawk Lake Highway. Undeveloped carry-in boat launch 200 yards past the campground entrance (no-wake lake). Near the Sinkhole Pathway limestone sinkholes and the 70-mile High Country Pathway. Most sites are wooded and set back from the water. ORVs are not allowed in the campground. --Claude
